THE WITHERWOOD SOVEREIGN — blighted forest realm where no wind has moved in a century; foreground: bark split into black lattice, roots curled upward like drowning hands clutching nothing; midground: dense canopy of dead oaks forming a lightless cathedral tunnel, pale fungal colonies glowing sickly amber at their bases; deep distance: a crown of antler-shaped dead trees silhouetted against bruised violet; sky: a permanent false dusk, plum-dark and absolutely motionless.

BLACKWATER MERE — poisoned wetland realm where the water remembers every drowned soul; foreground: black reeds snapped at chest-height, gas bubbles rising slowly through oil-slick water around skeletal boots half-submerged; midground: a vast drowned fortress visible beneath the surface, its towers intact, its windows lit from within by pale green luminescence; deep distance: fog columns rising from submerged bell towers; sky: low, wool-thick cloud pressing down like a lid.

THE CINDER EXPANSE — ash-plain wasteland stretching beyond all reckoning; foreground: volcanic glass shards embedded in grey ash like broken teeth, heat shimmer distorting the nearest rocks; midground: a miles-wide field of cracked lava-cooled earth divided by hairline orange fissures that breathe heat upward; deep distance: a ridgeline of smoking black peaks arranged in a ring like a crown; sky: a perpetual amber-grey haze with no visible sun.

ORVENMAAR THE OPEN GRAVE — cursed necropolis of a civilization that refused to end; foreground: cobblestones tilted by roots of bone, burial urns shattered and hollow at the roadside; midground: rows of tiered mausoleums with doors torn outward from within, spectral light seeping through cracked stone; deep distance: a bone-tower district rising behind the ruins, each spire topped with a stone effigy in mourning posture; sky: ash-grey with drifting funeral-cloth banners hung on nothing.

THE CHAINED MOORS — demon-touched heath where old summoning grounds still burn; foreground: iron chains embedded in the earth, links too large for any human forge, half-buried and crusted with rust; midground: a wide scorched heath marked with concentric circles of blackened stone, the grass between them red as dried blood; deep distance: a breach in the earth three leagues wide, emitting dark orange heat-light; sky: sulphur-yellow clouds rotating slowly overhead, never dissipating.

THORNHEX WASTE — cursed moor claimed by hag-rite generations before memory; foreground: blackthorn branches woven into low arches over the path, each thorn bearing a shriveled red bead; midground: a vast treeless moor under permanent slanted rain the color of weak ash, blood-stone megaliths arranged in a broken circle; deep distance: a single dead hillfort on a ridge, its timbers standing despite everything; sky: a racing dark ceiling where clouds move against the wind.

THE SUNDERED RIM — abyss-edge where the continent fractured and never healed; foreground: fractured flagstones tilting toward the drop, centuries of rope-anchors rusted to stumps; midground: a vast cliff face dropping into absolute purple-black darkness, the opposite edge of the abyss barely visible through distance-haze three leagues away; deep distance: void-touched mineral veins glowing dull violet in the canyon wall; sky: a thin strip overhead, iron-grey, the only remaining sky visible from the bottom of the wound.

ASHENVEIL MARCHES — blighted forest where the corruption entered through the roots; foreground: ground-level detail of black ash coating every exposed surface, dead leaves preserved in brittleness crumbling underfoot; midground: a vast wood of silver-barked trees stripped of all bark from mid-trunk down, leaving pale raw wood that glistens wrongly; deep distance: the forest's interior darkness, absolute and total, a wall of black between the outer trees; sky: filtered pale-grey light giving the clearing the look of an operating room.

THE PLAGUE DELTA — poisoned wetland at the river's cursed mouth; foreground: standing water the color of old copper, surface broken only by the curved spines of something large just below; midground: a wide estuary of interconnected plague-pools divided by mud levees, each pool a different shade of wrong — black, brass, deep arterial red; deep distance: a drowned cathedral with its highest spire still above water, bell intact; sky: an unnaturally yellow-green vault pressing flat, no clouds, no movement.

MORVETH'S APPROACH — dark citadel foreland where the keep begins half a league before its walls; foreground: a road of black basalt slabs lined with stone soldiers at attention, their faces worn to smooth ovals; midground: a killing-ground of churned dark earth descending to a moat of still black water; deep distance: the necromancer-keep itself, a vertical blade of black stone rising six hundred feet, windows like narrow wounds; sky: storm-cloud permanently fixed above the tower, lit from within by slow lightning.

THE VERMILLION FEN — poisoned wetland of the blood-river watershed; foreground: mud the color of rust with the consistency of old wax, boot-prints filling slowly with dark red seepage; midground: a wide slow river running deep crimson through a fen of hollow reeds, will-o-wisps hovering just above the surface in clusters; deep distance: the silhouette of a drowned-fortress wall, only its battlements above the flood-level; sky: a livid orange-purple band at the horizon beneath a ceiling of absolute grey.

CAIRN ASHFELD — ash-plain where the final battle was fought and never concluded; foreground: weapons and helms half-buried in white-grey ash, arrangement too regular to be random; midground: a vast flat plain of compacted ash stretching miles, broken only by the outlines of fallen siege engines consumed to their iron skeletons; deep distance: the silhouette of an army — still, upright, facing the viewer — impossible at this distance to determine if stone, ash-preserved, or standing; sky: a flat white sky with no horizon line visible.

THE WYTCHFEN SOVEREIGNTY — witch-realm of blackthorn and blood-stone; foreground: a path of flat black stones set in dark earth, each stone carved with a different face that looks slightly different each time viewed; midground: a fen of black water divided by causeways of packed earth, dolmens standing at each intersection draped with grey cloth; deep distance: a hilltop structure of interlocked stone arches, firelight visible in its center burning green; sky: a churning low overcast rotating counterclockwise, shedding light no sun should produce.

VORRETH GATE — crumbling dark citadel foreland at the border of the blighted kingdom; foreground: a gatehouse portcullis half-descended, its iron teeth embedded in cobblestone, vines of black thorn growing through every gap; midground: the outer ward of a fallen empire's fortress city, roofless halls open to the sky, occupation-era debris fossilized in mud; deep distance: the inner keep's intact towers, dark fire visible in narrow windows, occupation new despite the ruin; sky: a wide flat cloud base lit orange from below by unseen sources.

GELID HOLLOWS — blighted forest realm of permanent frozen corruption; foreground: ice-encased black bark, trapped within each frozen section a face in mid-expression, perfectly preserved; midground: a vast forest of glass-clear ice-trees still standing, branches fused into a lattice canopy overhead; deep distance: an ice-locked lake at the forest's heart, its surface showing the outlines of a submerged city beneath; sky: a pale silver-white overcast that emits cold light like the underside of sea ice.

THE EMBER TUNDRA — volcanic wasteland at the northern blighted latitude; foreground: permafrost ground cracked open by upwelling volcanic heat, revealing glowing orange beneath a grey crust; midground: a wide plain of volcanic rock alternating black basalt and orange-glowing fissures stretching to every compass point; deep distance: a range of volcanic peaks in constant low eruption, their smoke columns connecting to the cloud base; sky: the ash cloud layer thick enough to block all direct light, ambient glow from the fissures below.

THE DEAD CONVERGENCE — cursed necropolis where all roads of the blighted kingdom end; foreground: a crossroads of four sunken roads, the ditches alongside filled with offerings to no god worth naming; midground: a city of open tombs, every crypt door removed and stacked neatly beside its threshold, the city laid out in a rigid mourning-grid; deep distance: a central avenue leading to a palace-tomb at perfect geometric center; sky: a ring of dark clouds with a clear circle overhead allowing a single beam of cold white light onto the palace roof.

HELLSGAP MARCHES — demon-touched lowland where an infernal portal sealed imperfectly; foreground: ground tiles of dark stone cracked along lines that glow deep red-orange, heat audible in the air; midground: a wide flat expanse of scorched earth surrounding a sealed portal-arch still standing, its keystone glowing, chains of black iron wrapped around it in layers; deep distance: a ring of dark standing stones at the outer boundary, each stone tilted toward the arch; sky: a pressure-dome of cloud directly above the sealed portal, rotating.

THE SUNDERED PASS — abyss-edge where two mountain ranges tore apart in the world-wound event; foreground: a collapsed bridge of ancient construction, its near-side ending in a clean vertical drop, the far-side visible across a quarter-league of open air; midground: the canyon walls, thousands of feet of exposed geological strata, void-touched mineral veins glowing pale blue at depth; deep distance: across the gap, a continuation road carved into the far cliff-face, still intact, leading somewhere; sky: open, iron-grey, with high winds visible in streaking ash-cloud.

SORRELMERE — blighted forest of the undead-touched wildwood; foreground: a carpet of dead moss, every filament of it upright and oriented in the same direction like static-charged fur; midground: vast ancient oaks, their canopies fused overhead, their trunks wrapped in grey lichen that pulses faintly when approached; deep distance: the wildwood's interior, where light bends slightly wrong and distances don't resolve correctly; sky: visible only in narrow slivers between canopy, deep bruised purple despite the hour.

THE DROWNING DELTA — poisoned wetland of the cursed river mouth where the city sank; foreground: carved stone column-tops visible just above water level, their capitals decorated with mourning figures; midground: a vast flooded district of submerged streets, rooftop ridgelines breaking the black water surface in a grid; deep distance: the tallest tower of the drowned city still standing above flood, its flame-tower still alight with green fire; sky: a permanent low fog ceiling, yellow-grey, moving in long parallel streaks.

GREYMANTLE MOOR — cursed moor at the kingdom's haunted northern edge; foreground: heather compressed to flat grey mat underfoot, every stem pointing inward toward the moor's center; midground: a featureless open moor under slanted grey rain, blood-stone standing stones at irregular intervals, their shadows falling wrong for the light's direction; deep distance: the moor's center, where a stone circle glows at its base with deep amber luminescence; sky: racing grey overcast at low altitude, the cloud-base level with distant hilltops.

THE MARROW DISTRICT — cursed necropolis quarter of the lich-king's capital; foreground: bone-inlaid cobblestones, every third stone a carved cranium set flush and polished smooth by centuries of use; midground: a market-district of elaborate bone-architecture, towers of stacked femur-shafts lashed with iron, archways of interlocked ribcage segments; deep distance: the lich-king's palace-spire rising behind, its silhouette wrong in the way of things too tall and too thin; sky: a permanent false night despite the hour, stars visible and arranged in no constellation ever charted.

ASHMERE VELD — ash-plain where the burning of the old world left its floor; foreground: a surface of white-grey compacted ash firm enough to walk on, footprints sinking an inch and holding perfectly; midground: a wide flat plain broken by the standing skeletons of burned structures, their stone elements intact, their timber elements vaporized; deep distance: a single enormous obsidian monolith at the plain's center, three hundred feet tall, unmarked, featureless; sky: a high thin ash-layer giving the light the quality of eclipse-light, directionally wrong and cold.

THE VEILED APPROACH — dark citadel foreland beneath the fortress of the sundered throne; foreground: a road of black iron ingots set as paving, the heat of the citadel above conducting downward faintly; midground: a tiered approach-way cut into living rock, each tier a defensive killing-ground, the carvings on the retaining walls depicting conquest scenes that end abruptly, story unfinished; deep distance: the citadel itself at the summit, a fortress-city of black and deep-red stone, siege-lights burning on every watchtower; sky: a corona of dark cloud fixed above the fortress, flickering with imprisoned lightning.

ASHENVEIL PLAIN — cinder-desert wasteland where no wind has moved in centuries; foreground cracked obsidian earth split by orange-glowing fissures leaking sulfurous vapor, dead warrior gauntlets half-buried in ash; midground rolling grey plains studded with blackened stone spires trailing smoke like burned candles; deep distance a collapsed volcanic ridge bleeding slow lava rivers; sky bruised purple-black, choked with permanent ashfall that swallows the sun whole.

THE DROWNED FORTRESS MERE — blackwater swamp built atop a sunken keep's battlements; foreground knee-deep plague-pool reflecting no sky, rimmed with bloated reed-corpses and pale fungal growths shaped like screaming mouths; midground flooded towers rising from the murk, their arrow-slits weeping black water; deep distance a drowned cathedral spire still crowned with its iron bell; sky perpetual yellow-grey fog pressing down like a lid.

WITHERMARK WOOD — undead-touched forest where the trees refuse to fall even dead; foreground gnarled black root systems erupting through frozen soil, wound with pale grave-moss and cracked bone fragments; midground skeletal oaks interlocked overhead forming a cathedral of rot, every branch antlered with dried mistletoe black as coal; deep distance a single massive blasted trunk radiating wrongness outward; sky invisible behind layered dead canopy, light arriving grey and sourceless.

SOULCAIRN THRESHOLD — spectral-army necropolis at the border of the living world; foreground shattered tombstones half-dissolved into luminous grey dust, soul-wisps drifting inches above cracked flagstone; midground open-grave avenues lined with roofless mausoleums, translucent soldiers standing motionless at their posts; deep distance a lich-king's tower of fused gravestones stabbing the sky, lit from within by cold violet fire; sky starless void-black pressing the horizon flat.

CAELID-CODED SCARLET WASTE — demon-touched volcanic flatland rotted by a divine curse; foreground red-cracked earth suppurating with scarlet ichor pooling in boot-print depressions, twisted iron spears of unknown armies jutting at wrong angles; midground waves of corrupted rust-red hills breathing faint crimson mist; deep distance a colossal broken fortification whose walls have partially merged with the infected landscape; sky sickly amber bleeding into arterial red at the crown.

THE BLACKTHORN HEATH — hag-haunted moor stitched with cursed standing stones; foreground ankle-deep black peat studded with shattered witch-markers, iron crow-cages empty but still swaying; midground rolling heathland choked with blackthorn so dense it forms walls, paths cutting through like wounds; deep distance a hag-circle of monoliths crowned with skull-lanterns burning green; sky low churning stormcloud lit from beneath by that green glow, never breaking, never releasing rain.

AVERNUS SCORCHED PLAIN — infernal-portal territory where the earth remembers hellfire; foreground brimstone-cracked flagstone roads, iron chains anchored to nothing trailing into smoking pits, char-black bones fused to the road surface; midground a flat hellscape of scorched red earth and overturned war-machines of bone and black iron; deep distance a hellfire-column rising from a summoning circle the size of a city; sky boiling orange-red cloud structured like frozen flame.

MORDOR ASH FIELDS — volcanic glass wasteland beneath the eye-coded ridgeline; foreground black volcanic-glass shards like a shattered mirror underfoot, each reflecting distorted firelight, ash settling like grey snow; midground flat obsidian plains broken by upthrust basalt columns trailing smoke-banners; deep distance the jagged ridgeline glowing malevolently at the saddle where firelight bleeds through; sky permanent black overcast strobed internally by deep orange, as if the clouds themselves are burning.

THE BLOODROOT GLADE — hag-marked forest where the trees feed on something worse than water; foreground exposed root systems thick as tree-trunks running above soil, dark reddish-brown and glistening, pooling into crimson rivulets; midground ancient black-bark forest leaning inward overhead, bark carved with symbols that weren't put there by any hand; deep distance a hollow of impossible darkness at the grove's center that absorbs all light; sky tree-locked, a fractured patchwork of sick amber through dead leaves.

DEAD MARSHES REACH — will-o-wisp marsh studded with the faces of the long-fallen; foreground dark mirror-flat water between hummocks of pale dying sedge, each pool lit from below by cold wandering lights; midground endless reed-flats stretching to fog, occasional iron helmet visible beneath the surface; deep distance a fog-wall so dense it registers as a physical barrier, with pale lights shifting behind it; sky pewter and featureless, light arriving from no direction at all.

THE SUNDERED RIFT — abyss-edge cliff where a continent tore itself in two; foreground raw-edged rock at the precipice, crystal formations dark purple and wrong-angled jutting upward, void-touched soil crumbling into nothing at the lip; midground the rift itself, impossibly wide, walls of layered dark stone descending beyond sight; deep distance the opposite wall of the sundered continent visible as a dark mass, impossibly far, lights moving along it that should not exist; sky void-touched grey with no horizon line, just edge and abyss.

NECROPOLIS OF VAEL — lich-king kingdom where the city never finished dying; foreground cracked boulevard paving under centuries of bone-dust accumulation, iron lampposts still burning black flame; midground streets of roofless towers, each window a hollow eye socket, undead figures standing in doorways motionless and watching; deep distance the central Sepulcher-Citadel, seven black spires fused into one crown, lit violet from the throne-room; sky purple-black with threads of cold lightning moving between the spires silently.

CRUMBLING VAREK GATE — dark citadel foreland, the approach to a necromancer-keep; foreground shattered black flagstone road flanked by toppled colossal statues of armored figures, faces deliberately defaced, stumps of arms still gesturing; midground the killing field before the keep — scorched, crater-pocked, strewn with remnants of a thousand failed sieges; deep distance the necromancer-keep itself riding a cliff edge, walls the color of old bone, banners of black nothing hanging from every merlon; sky iron-grey clouds pressing like a ceiling, roof of the world.

GOLGOROTH FEN — plague-pool wetland where water has forgotten how to flow; foreground stagnant black-green water with an oily iridescence, pale corruption-blooms floating in clusters, warped wooden dock-posts listing at wrong angles; midground collapsed village foundations half-submerged, rooflines forming low walls of rot above the waterline; deep distance a drowned bell-tower, its bell still visible beneath the surface, ringing silently in no current; sky mustard-yellow fog layer so uniform it reads as a second ground above.

THE WITCH-FEN OF HARROW — blood-stone field edging a cursed witch-fen; foreground rust-red stones embedded in black peat, each carved with a bound figure, shallow channels between them filled with standing dark water; midground the fen itself — bog-oak skeletons draped in hanging grey moss, pale lights drifting at chest-height; deep distance a collapsed tower grown through entirely by black briar, barely distinguishable from the thorns; sky churning charcoal overcast, occasional sick green flash in the cloud-base.

CINDER THROAT WASTES — smoking-fissure ash plain in the shadow of a dead volcano; foreground deep cracks in baked earth exhaling thin white smoke, dried lava channels like petrified rivers of black glass; midground grey-white ash dunes sculpted by heat-winds into razor-edged formations, visibility collapsing in drifting plumes; deep distance the volcano's cone, collapsed on one side, a permanent glowing wound at its broken edge; sky ashfall so heavy it creates false twilight at noon, orange-grey, oppressively close.

THE ROTWOOD MERE — poisoned wetland at the heart of a blighted forest collision; foreground black tree-roots descending into poisoned water the color of old bruises, fungal shelf-growth on every surface glowing faintly sickly yellow; midground the forest-wetland boundary — trees half-drowned standing dead, crowns still intact above the waterline; deep distance an ancient druidic circle of standing stones barely above the water, all listing, all wrong; sky perpetual twilight filtering through dead canopy into greenish murk.

SOUL CAIRN INTERIOR — undead-walked ruin field of a spectral kingdom's remnants; foreground grey dust-plane littered with soul-gem shards catching cold blue light, small bone-cairns built by hands long gone; midground fields of abstract soul-monuments — abstract architecture no living tradition built — rising in irregular clusters; deep distance a Boneyard Colossus visible through haze, a structure of fused remains the size of a mountain; sky absolute void-black, no stars, a sourceless cold blue light coming from everywhere and nowhere.

DREADMIRE CROSSING — cursed marsh where the road exists only as a suggestion; foreground submerged causeway barely visible under dark water, traveler's abandoned boots on its edge, pale handprints in the mud pointing into the deeper water; midground infinite reed-marsh in every direction, fog rolling between stalks at waist height, will-o-wisps clustering in the distance; deep distance the far shore — if it is a shore — a mass of black willow draped in grey, watching; sky uniform ash-white, no depth, no gradient.

THE DEMON CIRCLE OF ASHKARATH — infernal-portal area where the sky was breached once; foreground scorched black circle of earth, still warm, iron sigil-posts around its perimeter chained together with black iron links; midground concentric rings of scorched wasteland expanding outward, each ring a different degree of ruin; deep distance the portal scar — a vertical wound in the air that healed wrong, still seeping red-orange heat-light at its seam; sky structured like a wound from horizon to zenith, orange-black, permanently damaged.

THE WORLDWOUND EDGE — sundered abyss where the land simply ends and wrongness begins; foreground raw broken earth at the precipice, reality-damaged stone that shifts subtly underfoot, black crystal growths emerging from cracks; midground the wound itself — not a canyon, a tear — walls of compressed dark matter and broken geography, old buildings from a consumed civilization embedded sideways in the walls; deep distance darkness total and structured, as if something enormous waits at depth; sky split precisely above the rift — normal grey on one side, nothing on the other.

KORRETH NECROPOLIS OUTSKIRTS — open-grave city where the suburbs of death stretch for miles; foreground raised earthen burial mounds split open from within, soil dark and loose, grave-goods scattered and trampled; midground a district of mausoleums stripped of their doors, black interiors visible, pale movement inside; deep distance the necropolis proper rising as a skyline of black spires and bone-white dome-tombs, backlit by cold violet storm-glow; sky green-black stormfront stalled directly overhead, not moving, not breaking.

THORNWASTE SOVEREIGN — blighted forest reclaiming a dead kingdom's open fields; foreground black briar roots thick as arms erupting through shattered tile flooring of a palace garden, iron fountains seized with growth; midground the palace complex overgrown, every window a tangle of black thorn, rooflines collapsed inward and replaced by briar-crown; deep distance the throne-tower, only its upper third visible above the canopy of dead thorn, its crown broken, a single raven-black tree growing from the throne room; sky iron-grey, flat, offering no mercy.

THE IRON CHOKE PASS — dark citadel foreland where armies came and did not pass; foreground the road littered with the corroded remnants of a thousand-year siege, iron siege-engine ribs rusting into the road surface; midground the pass itself — sheer black cliff faces carved with the citadel's propaganda, now half-defaced by centuries; deep distance the citadel's gate towers visible between cliff walls, portcullis still down, still sealed, still waiting; sky a perfect slot of sky overhead showing nothing but bruised cloud, oppressive and channeled.

THE ASHEN MERE OF SOLGRETH — volcanic wasteland meeting cursed marsh at a poisoned delta; foreground black volcanic silt mixing with dark water in viscous swirls, dead reed-stalks coated in grey ash standing rigid; midground a wide flat expanse of ash-covered water reflecting dull orange from distant lava-flow, the surface occasionally breaking with slow dark bubbles; deep distance a volcanic shelf glowing hot at its lip, pouring slow orange into the dark water below; sky smoke and steam colliding overhead into a permanent false ceiling of churning grey-orange.

GREYMARROW WOOD — blighted forest of petrified black oaks strangled by pulsing violet veins; foreground gnarled roots erupting through frost-cracked soil, each tip weeping dark amber resin; midground a cathedral of leafless canopy so dense no light penetrates, shapes moving between trunks that should not move; deep distance a pale smear of dead horizon where the wood simply ends into nothing; sky a bruised ceiling of motionless cloud pressing down like a lid.

THE DROWNED REACHES — cursed blackwater marsh where an entire fortress kingdom sank three centuries past; foreground black mud studded with drowned battlements, iron portcullises jutting at wrong angles like broken teeth; midground still obsidian water reflecting no sky, surface furred with luminescent plague-bloom; deep distance half-submerged towers trailing spectral banners of pale mist; sky absolute grey, featureless, erasing all sense of time or season.

ASHFELD MOURNE — volcanic wasteland of compacted grey cinders stretching to the edge of sight; foreground cooled lava tongues cracked into hexagonal plates, each fissure breathing sluggish orange breath; midground an endless flat plain interrupted only by toppled black basalt pillars like a shattered colonnade of giants; deep distance a ridge of smoking volcanic glass refracting hellish amber light; sky perpetual ash-fall softening everything into monochrome ruin.

VAULDREN NECROPOLIS — open-grave city of the long-dead built entirely from stacked bone and mortared ash; foreground fractured cobblestones pushing up femur-pale stonework, withered offerings at every threshold; midground avenue upon avenue of bone-tower tenements, hollow windows flickering with cold spectral candlelight; deep distance a throne-spire of fused skulls rising above all others, crowned in silent green flame; sky starless void pressing impossibly close.

THE BLEED MOOR — hag-haunted cursed heath soaked a permanent arterial rust-red; foreground tufts of black grass stiff as wire, bloodstone cairns carved with spiral curses, ground soft and giving underfoot in wrong ways; midground rolling darkness of moor under perpetual mist-fog, pale shapes standing motionless at irregular intervals; deep distance crooked black thornwood treeline marking the hag-realm border; sky the color of a bruise yellowing at the edges, sick and wrong.

SCORCHGATE PLAIN — demon-touched scorched earth surrounding a collapsed infernal portal; foreground cracked terracotta ground threaded with cooling hellfire veins, chains of black iron half-buried in cinder; midground a vast scorched clearing where nothing grows and the air shimmers with residual heat-hatred; deep distance the portal arch still standing, enormous, warped, radiating wrongness through the landscape; sky torn by thermal drafts into ragged amber streaks.

SOULCAIRN FLATS — sundered land of void-touched ash-pale stone where the world simply cracked open; foreground loose shale sheeting away over a cliff edge with no visible bottom, carved runes along the rim still glowing cold blue; midground a fractured plateau honeycombed with chasms, spectral mist rising from below like exhalation; deep distance the far wall of the sundered valley impossibly distant, half dissolved in void-haze; sky a thin sickly lavender with no sun.

THE WITHERING — blighted forest grove where every tree is turned away, branches straining from the center as if fleeing something at the heart; foreground shattered bark exposing white heartwood stained black from within, leaves calcified to grey flakes on the frozen ground; midground a ring of toppled ancient oaks collapsed inward around a dead clearing; deep distance a single impossibly tall blackened spire-tree, leafless, watching; sky an ocher smear barely distinguishable from the treeline.

PLAGUEFEN HOLLOWS — poisoned wetland of still copper-green water laced with blight-smoke; foreground skeletal reeds crusted with yellow mineral deposit, ribcages of unknown scale just beneath the surface; midground islands of rotting vegetation connected by half-submerged stone bridges slick with black moss; deep distance a drowned church steeple, bells gone, tower colonized by something vast and pale; sky low cloud lit sickly green from below by the water's own diseased luminescence.

EMBER THRONE WASTES — Mordor-coded volcanic plain at the foot of a continent-spanning obsidian ridge; foreground volcanic glass shards like black knife-blades thrusting from grey pumice, air tasting of sulfur and old iron; midground a lava-cracked plain where every fissure spells ruin in some geological language; deep distance the ridge itself, kilometres high, bleeding orange light from a thousand vents like watching eyes; sky choked red-brown with volcanic particulate, sun a pale disc behind smoke.

HEXENMOOR — witch-realm heath under a permanent twilight that has not brightened in living memory; foreground black thornbushes heavy with shriveled dark berries no creature eats, carved bone-staves planted at intervals marking boundaries unseen; midground the moor surface shifting almost imperceptibly, ground breathing; deep distance a low structure of rough black stone half-grown-over with thorn, windows sealed with wax and curse-rags; sky a flat pewter that swallows sound.

IRONVAULT APPROACH — crumbling dark citadel foreland of a fallen necromancer-fortress atop a shattered promontory; foreground a broken causeway of cracked slate flagstones, iron torch-brackets empty but stained by decades of black flame; midground collapsed outer walls stretched across the approach, gap-toothed and draped in dead ivy black as tar; deep distance the keep itself impossibly tall against the skyline, windows dark save one blazing amber pinnacle; sky storm-anvil cloud forming directly above as if drawn.

SUNDERCLEFT — world-wound canyon where the continent tore and never healed; foreground the lip of the abyss, stone warped and fused by forces geological and arcane both, etched with impact-cracks radiating outward; midground the void-touched chasm dropping into absolute darkness interrupted only by floating slabs of drifting stone caught between falling and hovering; deep distance the far wall fading into void-mist, its features indistinct; sky pale and wrong, the horizon line disturbed by the earth's own wound.

THE BLACK DELUGE — cursed marsh of blood-river tributaries feeding into a central still expanse of dark crimson; foreground fine rust-red silt underfoot, old stone road dissolving into the delta, helmet half-submerged at road's edge; midground slow-moving channels of dark water parting through reed-islands, will-o-wisps describing slow ellipses above the surface; deep distance a sunken fortress complex only visible at low water, walls and towers shortened to stumps; sky heavy ochre, sun absent, light sourceless and amber.

CINDER PILGRIMS ROAD — ash-plain processional highway through a cinder desert where a civilization burned; foreground cobblestone road cracked and heaved by heat, ash drifted waist-high against its edges, pilgrim-staffs snapped off at ground level; midground ash-buried city blocks visible as geometric mounds, a buried metropolis; deep distance a volcanic caldera rim defining the horizon, crater mouth breathing black into the sky; sky deep charcoal, ash-fall rendering distance as texture rather than space.

LICHGATE KINGDOM — cursed necropolis of a functional undead civilization, streets still mapped and named; foreground flagstone streets inscribed with the names and death-dates of every buried citizen, a census carved in stone; midground tall narrow buildings of black granite, doors open, interiors lit by cold white light, movement within; deep distance a palace of the same black granite scaled for a ruler who no longer breathes, throne-room window blazing cold-blue; sky heavy purple pressing the city into shadow.

THE CHARRED APOSTASY — demon-touched field where a summoning circle miles across was inscribed and used; foreground vitrified soil black and glassy underfoot, iron chains of enormous scale emerging from ground at cardinal points; midground the circle's outer ring still faintly luminous in dried hellfire-residue, nothing grows within it, nothing grows within sight of it; deep distance the circle's center, a crater of collapsed earth, still radiating heat shimmer; sky permanently scarred by what passed through, clouds refusing to close the wound.

WYCHTHORNE BARROWS — cursed moor surrounding a field of burial mounds too regular, too numerous, too recent; foreground black grass shorn flat by wind, barrow entrances sealed with iron rings and chain, some broken open from within; midground hundreds of earthen mounds extending to the eye's limit, paths between them narrow and deliberate; deep distance the oldest barrow, enormous, its stones visible above the earthen cap, exuding cold mist; sky wind-scoured and pale silver, sound swallowed by the open ground.

PUTRESCENT BOG — poisoned wetland where a plague's epicenter has become a geography; foreground thick black mud erupting in slow viscous bubbles releasing yellow gas, old bridges of lashed timber blackened and swollen; midground the bog widening into a lake of clouded dark water, surface disturbed by unseen movement below; deep distance an island of elevated ground holding a collapsed hospice, its bell-tower leaning; sky the color of old parchment, mist sealing the scene from the world above.

THE UNMADE SHORE — sundered abyss-edge coastline where the land simply ends and no sea fills the gap; foreground fractured cliff-face of black granite etched with tidal markings from a sea that retreated or was taken; midground a series of collapsed sea-stacks, the stone between them gone, leaving isolated pillars above an abyss; deep distance more pillars, progressively hazier, until they dissolve in void-fog; sky a deep indigo that is neither day nor night but something the world does not have a word for.

STAGHORN BLIGHT — twisted wood of antlered black trees grown so entangled overhead they form a solid canopy-vault; foreground antler-like branches descending to ground level, some having re-rooted, forming arched cages across the forest floor; midground a colonnade of these arch-cages extending forward, each framing darkness; deep distance faint luminescence where something rests at the wood's heart, cold and pale and still; sky invisible beneath the canopy, its absence a presence of its own.

AVERNUS SCAR — hellscape-adjacent scorched-earth borderland where the material world grows thin; foreground baked red clay cracked into scales, iron spikes of infernal design emerging from below, sulfur-crystal formations at their bases; midground a flat killing ground of absolute barrenness between the world above and what presses from below; deep distance a horizon line of black iron walls, enormous, the border fortification of something that should not need borders; sky bruised red darkening to black at zenith.

THE GREY PROCESSION — spectral-army necropolis foreland where an undead host camps in eternal readiness; foreground frost-rimed earth pressed flat by the weight of countless encampments, tattered pennants driven into ground at squad-intervals; midground the army itself, motionless in formation, grey-armored, facing a direction with no apparent destination; deep distance the necropolis that birthed them, a city of tombs and towers arranged in military order; sky the absolute white-grey of overcast midwinter, light even and directionless and cold.

DEADFALL HIGHLANDS — blighted forest transformed into a highland bone-field of fallen ancient trees never decomposing; foreground enormous fallen trunks silver-white and hard as stone, the forest floor carpeted in preserved dead leaves frozen mid-fall; midground a labyrinth of deadfall at chest-height, impassable to anything but the patient dead; deep distance standing trunks at the wood's edge still upright but skeletal, leafless, pale, arranged like sentinels; sky a thin cold blue drained of warmth, winter permanent here.

GRAVEMARK FEN — poisoned wetland drainage basin of a shattered empire, estate walls still visible beneath black water; foreground shallows revealing mosaic floors beneath inches of dark water, estate furniture of marble still in place; midground deeper channels cutting through the drowned aristocratic quarter, iron garden gates rusted to lace; deep distance the estate's central manor, upper floors still above waterline, every window dark, every door open; sky a flat silver mirror above the flat black water, world sandwiched between two sheets of void.

ASHENMERE DESOLATION — blighted ash plain where no wind stirs yet ash perpetually falls; foreground shattered obsidian shards half-buried in grey silt, each edge sharp enough to flay; midground cracked earth split by cooling magma veins that pulse like diseased arteries; deep distance a volcanic ridge crowned by a collapsed fortress-crown belching silent black smoke; sky a permanent bruised amber ceiling pressing down like a lid on a tomb.

THE WITHERWOOD — blighted forest of blackened oaks stripped of bark to bone-white wood; foreground exposed root systems knotted like clutching fingers gripping nothing, black ichor weeping from split bark; midground a cathedral of dead trunks leaning inward, canopy replaced by interlocking bare branches blocking all light; deep distance a single massive elder-tree split by ancient lightning, its hollow glowing with sickly violet; sky starless pitch broken only by slow-drifting grey spore-clouds.

PLAGUEPOOL FENS — poisoned wetland where the water is the colour of old bruises; foreground half-submerged ribcages of enormous beasts, draped in black waterlogged moss, bubbles rising without sound; midground flat stagnant channels threading between islands of pale sedge-grass that trembles without wind; deep distance a drowned keep's tower top jutting above the waterline, its banner still flying but wrong, inverted; sky low yellow fog that smells of nothing good.

GRAVENMOOR — cursed moor of blood-stone standing stones arranged in geometries no living surveyor charted; foreground boot-swallowing black peat spotted with frost despite no cold, each stone bleeding rust-red mineral water; midground rolling heath of blackthorn scrub, every branch ending in a spine long as a finger; deep distance the outline of a collapsed hag-keep split across a hillcrest like a broken crown; sky churning burgundy cloud-shelf that never resolves into rain.

CINDER MARCHES — volcanic wasteland of glass-smooth lava-rock plains cracked into vast dark tiles; foreground volcanic glass formations rising knee-height, refracting hellish orange from below, edges razor-perfect; midground the plain stretching flat for a mile before the land buckles upward into a pressure-ridge of torn stone; deep distance three dormant volcanic cones forming a trident silhouette against the haze, their summits each capped by a skeletal iron watchtower; sky a false dusk of suspended ash blotting the sun to a red smear.

THE BONE WARRENS — cursed necropolis of streets paved with compressed ossuary fill; foreground flagstones made visibly of compacted bones, the outlines of hands and skulls pressed flat underfoot; midground avenues flanked by bone-tower tenements stacked seven stories, each window dark and watchful; deep distance the central cathedral-spire of the lich-king rising impossibly tall, wrapped in slow-rotating spectral light; sky dead black with a single pale moon casting no warmth, only revelation.

SUNDERED VALE — void-touched canyon where the world simply ends in a sheer wrongness; foreground cliff-edge crumbled to gravel that hovers in place rather than falling, as though gravity forgot; midground the canyon walls of exposed striated stone showing the geological cross-section of an entire age sliced open; deep distance the far wall is missing — only void, the deep dark blue-black of absolute absence; sky normal above, normal below the rim, but inside the canyon the sky is simply gone.

BLACKTHORN VALE — blighted forest of thorned hedge-mazes grown beyond any gardener's reckoning; foreground thorns the length of short-swords glistening with something dark and not quite moisture; midground hedgerows forty feet tall enclosing passages that end in sudden drops or collapsed archways; deep distance at the maze-heart a dead fountain basin, its stone figures frozen mid-scream in arrested carving; sky a canopy of interlocked thorn-branches forming a ceiling through which sickly green filters impossibly.

THE DEAD MARSHES — poisoned wetland lit by cold corpse-lights drifting just below the waterline; foreground black water inches deep over a silt floor, ghostly faces visible beneath the surface, beatific and wrong; midground a causeway of stepping-stone slabs, each tilting slightly, crossing channels where the lights cluster thickest; deep distance a collapsed aqueduct stretching horizon to horizon, its arches crumbling into the water at intervals; sky permanent mist at ceiling-height, grey-white, diffusing no light but somehow present everywhere.

AVERNUS APPROACH — demon-touched scorched-earth plain where the ground still remembers fire; foreground cracked terracotta earth leaking thin threads of sulphurous smoke through every fissure; midground rusted chains the thickness of a man's torso lying slack across the plain, fastened at both ends to nothing visible; deep distance an infernal gate-arch of black iron three hundred feet tall standing alone, its threshold a shimmer of heat-haze and wrongness; sky choked red with particulate, the sun reduced to a copper coin behind gauze.

WYRMFELL NECROPOLIS — cursed city of the dead where the buildings still stand but nothing lives; foreground a street of intact market stalls, goods laid out, no sellers, dust-covered, perfectly preserved in abandonment; midground the city in full plan view from a raised approach road, towers and domes intact, utterly silent; deep distance the palace at city-centre, its dome collapsed inward, from which a column of spectral mist rises vertically with terrible purpose; sky parchment-coloured, the light sourceless and flat, casting no shadows anywhere.

THE SHATTERED CONTINENT EDGE — sundered land where tectonic wrongness split the world and left it open; foreground tilted slabs of stone the size of houses leaning against each other like broken teeth; midground a jumbled terrain of rock-islands in a sea of deeper shadow, each island separated by chasms of unknown depth; deep distance the mainland cliff-face showing the clean ancient cut where the land tore, its wound-face exposed strata still raw; sky divided precisely at the fault-line, one half storm-grey, the other amber, the boundary a straight line overhead.

VEILMOOR — witch-realm heath where the fog moves against the wind; foreground black peat hags rising from the moor like stooped figures, deceptively human at distance; midground pools of standing water with no inlet or outlet, surfaces absolutely still and mirror-perfect despite no cause; deep distance three hilltops each bearing a different ruin — tower, ring-wall, arch — arranged too deliberately to be coincidence; sky low, fast-moving grey cloud with no weather beneath it, just oppressive ceiling-pressure and silence.

THE IRON FORELAND — dark citadel approach across a trampled killing field gone to cursed wasteland; foreground churned dark earth set with broken spear-hafts and shattered shields, no bodies, as though war happened but left no dead; midground a slope of dead grass the colour of old straw rising toward massive curtain walls; deep distance the necromancer-keep crowning the hill, its towers uneven and organic-seeming, as though grown rather than built; sky a permanent lenticular cloud sits motionless above the keep, shaped almost like a crown, almost like an eye.

SOULCAIRN PLATEAU — ash plain trapped between life and death where colour has simply stopped working; foreground pale grey-white soil fine as talcum, footprints sinking deep and remaining, no wind to fill them; midground crystal formations of soul-stone rising from the plateau floor in irregular clusters, faintly luminous and deeply wrong; deep distance enormous fossil ribs of something incomprehensible arching above the plateau like a ruined cathedral nave; sky stripped of blue, of grey, of any tone — the overhead is the white of a cataract, featureless and blind.

PLAGUEBLOOD RIVER — poisoned wetland corridor where the river itself is the threat; foreground riverbank of black glutinous mud printed with tracks of things that move at night; midground the river's surface dark red-brown, slow-moving, viscous, catching no reflections because it absorbs light; deep distance a bridge of ancient stone spanning the river, its central arch collapsed, the gap bridged by something organic and ropelike; sky a thin persistent drizzle that is not rain, the droplets too dark, staining pale stone where they land.

CAELID WASTES — demon-touched rot-plain where the very soil is infected with something that has no name; foreground ground the colour of dried blood, cracked into plates, scarlet dust rising with each step; midground enormous ribcages of fallen titans half-buried in the rot-earth, used as shelter by things unseen; deep distance a malformed colossus standing at the horizon, motionless, arms raised, whether in surrender or summoning unclear; sky a permanent aurora of infected red-orange, the clouds themselves bloated and wrong-shaped, tumorous.

THE DROWNED FORTRESS — poisoned wetland around a submerged castle's upper works; foreground knee-deep black water over sunken cobblestones, the grid of the streets still navigable by feel; midground battlements emerging from the water at intervals, the walls intact below the waterline, the crenellations above colonised by black moss; deep distance the great hall's roof, the only fully above-water structure, its windows dark, from one a light moves slowly; sky permanent rain, not heavy, not cold, just endless, the kind that erases you gradually.

THORNWALL ABYSS — sundered land where the cliff-edge is also a boundary between what is and what should not be; foreground black thorned scrub at the cliff lip, roots gripping stone with desperate tenacity; midground the cliff-edge itself, the drop beginning in shadow and continuing into darkness that grows no lighter with distance; deep distance across the void the opposite cliff is visible but dimensionally wrong — too tall, too close, the strata running sideways; sky above the abyss the stars are visible despite full daylight, points of cold light in a blue-black impossible window.

WRAITHFEN — cursed marsh alive with spectral movement at the edge of perception; foreground rotted boardwalk planks over sucking black mud, some planks missing, the gaps showing nothing below; midground columns of marsh-gas rising as slow cylinders that maintain their form too long before dispersing; deep distance the crown of a drowned watchtower barely above the marsh, on its parapet a figure standing absolutely still; sky green-tinged overcast, the light giving every surface a colour it should not have.

ASHGATE FORELAND — dark citadel approach through a field of volcanic memorial columns erected by the defeated; foreground the road paved in volcanic stone, its surface warm underfoot despite no nearby heat source; midground columns of dark basalt lining the road at intervals, each carved with the names of those the citadel consumed; deep distance the citadel gate visible between the columns, its portcullis raised, the dark within impenetrable; sky a permanent dust-haze at the citadel level, the upper towers disappearing into low cloud, never fully visible.

THE BLOOD-MOOR — witch-realm where the standing-stone circles are still active and the activation is visible; foreground boot-deep heather gone black and brittle as charcoal, crumbling to dust underfoot; midground the moor's surface level and vast, the standing-stone circles punctuating the flatness at intervals, each casting no shadow despite the visible light source; deep distance a larger formation, a henge-ring, its lintel-stones intact, the space within its ring a vertical slice of deeper darkness; sky slate grey, featureless, the light directionless and ancient.

SOUL-STRICKEN GALLERY — cursed necropolis district of civic grandeur turned monument to stillness; foreground a broad avenue with drained ornamental fountains, their basins containing only sediment and the outlines of fallen statuary; midground colonnaded civic buildings intact but wrong, their doors sealed with black iron, their windows showing interior light that should have no source; deep distance a grand arch spanning the avenue, from it chains descending to the street, at chain-end nothing, the chains ending mid-air; sky completely black above this district specifically, a dome of night over only this street.

THE CINDER FIELDS OF NARGETH — ash plain where an entire army was immolated and the ash remembers; foreground ash drifts shin-deep between ridges of fused earth, the drifts shaped like prone figures, almost; midground the fields extending flat, broken by the occasional standing ruin of a siege-engine charred to its iron bones; deep distance an enormous crown-shaped crater at the field-centre, still venting heat, its rim of fused glass catching the ash-light; sky a layered atmospheric column of suspended particulate reaching to the clouds, a permanent pillar of grey above the crater, a dark monument.

GRIMHOLT APPROACH — dark citadel foreland where the fortress has been visible on the horizon for three days of travel; foreground the last road-marker before the outer ward, a monolith carved with a single word in a dead language, the carving freshly deep despite the stone's age; midground the outer killing-ground of stumps where a forest was cleared to deny cover, the stumps black and oiled-seeming; deep distance Grimholt itself spanning the entire mountain-face behind it, the walls not built but merged with the rock, the distinction between fortress and mountain dissolved; sky at the citadel-peak level the sky is perpetually dark regardless of hour, an absolute black aperture.

ASHENMOOR CROSSING — blighted forest at witch-realm threshold; foreground blackened root-tangles split cracked earth, pale fungi clustered at their knots like rot-blooms; midground leafless iron-bark trees lean inward forming a crooked colonnade of dead wood, every branch ending in a blackened claw-curl; deep distance a smear of violet fog swallows the treeline; sky bruised amber pressing low, sunless and wrong.

THE DREADMIRE — poisoned wetland of black standing water; foreground half-submerged ribcages of enormous beasts ring the bank, green phosphorescence licking their arches; midground a flooded ruins-field, towers toppled at angles, their stones slick and dark, will-o-wisps drifting in aimless spirals between collapsed archways; deep distance a dead treeline barely visible through rolling plague-fog; sky starless, flat grey as a sealed vault.

CINDER REACH — volcanic wasteland, ash-plain of cracked obsidian tiles; foreground cooling lava seams hiss in hairline fractures across blackened ground, heat shimmer distorting close air; midground a vast plain of grey-white ash dunes broken by jagged volcanic glass formations like snapped black teeth; deep distance a ridge-wall of smoking fissures belching orange-lit columns upward; sky choked amber-black, the sun a bruised disc behind sulphur haze.

VAELTHAMUR — cursed necropolis, open-grave city of the sunken kingdom; foreground tomb-slabs heaved upward at angles from frost-cracked soil, grave-earth disturbed and fresh-dark; midground collapsed boulevards lined with bone-tower spires, architecture of ancient power now hollow, spectral lantern-light flickering in glassless windows; deep distance the lich-king's keep rises, black against grey sky; sky flat pewter, threaded with slow-moving burial smoke.

THE WYTCHFEN — cursed marsh of the hag-haunted borderlands; foreground gnarled black-thorn bushes claw from peat-water, roots looping above the surface like grasping fingers; midground a vast bog field of trembling water, standing stones sunk to half their height, bound with rotting rope and tallow offerings; deep distance a hill of dead elms, silhouette of a lone ruined tower; sky green-tinged, cloud-heavy, utterly windless and wrong.

SOULCAIRN BARRENS — sundered land, abyss-edge territory of collapsed stone; foreground loose shale crumbles at the precipice lip, pebbles dropping silently into colourless void below; midground fractured plateaus extend outward at differing levels, connected by collapsed bridge-spans, all stone bleached bone-white and cracked through; deep distance the canyon wall opposite shimmers with pale cursed light seeping from crevices; sky void-coloured, neither day nor dark.

BLOODWOOD VALE — blighted forest soaked in ancient battle-curse; foreground pooled dark-red earth around root-bases, bark split to reveal crimson heartwood veins pulsing; midground a dense twisted grove, tree trunks wide as towers, canopy so thick that midday arrives as twilight; deep distance the silhouette of a hanged fortress gate visible through branches; sky invisible, the canopy ceiling an interlocked mass of blackened bough.

THE PLAGUEMOUTH — poisoned wetland of a drowned fortress district; foreground black water laps at submerged marble stair-edges, oil-slick rainbows spreading across its surface; midground a sunken fortified town visible beneath shallow water, rooftops protruding, banners still attached to poles trailing in the current like drowned hair; deep distance a cathedral spire rises above the waterline, intact, all its windows dark; sky rust-orange fog, dense and low.

MOLTEN SHELF OF GORETHAK — demon-touched volcanic hellscape adjacent; foreground obsidian shards upthrust from scorched earth, demon-summoning circles carved into the flat stone between them, sigils still faintly glowing coal-red; midground a cracked plain where lava channels run in deliberate straight lines as though engineered by infernal hands; deep distance a hellfire-venting chasm rim, iron chains crossing its gap; sky burnt sienna, cloud-bellies lit from below by unseen fires.

THORNSPIRE NECROPOLIS — cursed necropolis of collapsed empire; foreground carved bone-column fragments scattered across frozen mud, inscriptions worn to illegible grooves; midground a district of leaning towers built from dark limestone, connected by enclosed sky-bridges most of which have snapped mid-span, dangling; deep distance a palace dome of blackened copper, caved inward, revealing the sky above like a wound; sky pewter and pressing, snow falling upward in wrong-drifting motes.

THE CARRION MOOR — cursed moor of blood-stone fields under witch-reign; foreground red-veined standing stones jut from heather blackened to wire-thin stalks, the stones warm to touch in freezing air; midground an undulating moorland of scorched earth and frost-dark peat, shapes beneath the surface pressing upward as irregular mounds with no clear origin; deep distance a silhouette ridge crowned with bone-frames on poles; sky gunmetal, low, the horizon line a wound of bruised purple.

THE SUNDERED VEIL — abyss-edge cliff above a world-wound valley; foreground raw stone lip, freshly torn, quartz veins exposed and glittering at the break-edge; midground the cliff face dropping sheer, exposing geological strata in dark bands; far below and across the void, the opposite wall of the wound miles distant, wrapped in void-touched mist; deep distance nothing resolves, only dimly lit fog filling the abyss; sky fracture-cloud formation above, radiating from the wound's epicentre.

GRIMHOLLOW FORELAND — crumbling citadel approach through dead-field corridor; foreground approach road of shattered flagstone, weeds long since blackened and petrified, no living thing; midground double row of decapitated statues flanking the road, their bases stained, the figures anonymous kings stripped of faces; deep distance the citadel's outer curtain wall looms, gatehouse intact, portcullis down, no light from any tower; sky leaden, a single crow-black standard still flying from the highest parapet.

DEADMARSH OF AELVOR — poisoned wetland, Dead-Marshes-coded remembrance field; foreground shallow water with faces visible below the surface, frozen in still expressions, neither alive nor fully gone; midground a flat endless bog broken only by clumps of black sedge-grass and collapsed wooden walkway sections rotting into the water; deep distance a treeline of dead willows, their trailing branches fingertip-touching the water; sky perpetual false-dawn orange, unchanging, no sun visible, just sourceless glow.

PETRIFIED GLOAMING — blighted forest of the stone-cursed wood; foreground petrified tree-roots at ground level, stone-grey and frozen mid-writhe, mosses turned to mineral dusting; midground standing petrified trunks of enormous girth, stone-grey but preserving every bark-texture detail perfectly, a forest frozen mid-scream; deep distance through stone-trunk columns, a valley floor of silver-grey mist; sky pale silver-white, featureless, the light coming from everywhere and nowhere, shadowless and wrong.

THE CHARNELFIELDS — cursed necropolis turned open-grave battlefield; foreground burial mounds cracked open from below, displaced earth fresh-dark around each rupture; midground a vast plain of disturbed graves extending to all horizons, spectral armoured figures standing at attention between the mounds, motionless; deep distance a great collapsed keep, its banners rotted to ragged pennant-scraps; sky shifting grey-green, a ring of pale light on the horizon as if dawn perpetually threatens and never arrives.

VANTHORPE ASHFIELDS — ash-plain of a post-catastrophe empire; foreground thick ash drifts piled against half-buried structures, the ash soft underfoot, yielding, soundless; midground a vast flat grey plain of compacted ash-crust, skeleton of a city grid visible beneath, streets and lots defined by buried walls barely protruding; deep distance a single intact column stands impossibly preserved, volcanic glass formations growing at its base; sky pale ash-white upper atmosphere above a black smear mid-level.

WITCHFEN CROSSROADS — hag-cursed moor at a night-ritual site; foreground a crossroads of four narrow paths meeting at a blood-stone marker, the stone cracked and stained dark, offerings of black candle-wax pooled at its base; midground the moor extends in all directions, low and featureless except for bent hawthorn silhouettes at intervals; deep distance fog banks sit dense and deliberate, three of the four paths ending blindly in white wall; sky moonless, starless, just dark felt pressing down.

EBONREACH CITADEL — dark citadel foreland approach, fall-of-empire scale; foreground a dried moat of cracked black mud, iron spikes still standing within it at intervals, tips corroded to points; midground the outer ward wall, immense, built from dark quarried stone, siege-damage visible in collapsed sections showing the rubble-fill inside; deep distance the inner keep tower rises above the wall, intact and entirely lightless, shadow even against shadow; sky permanent grey-violet of a world with a dying sun.

THE FROSTGRAVE NECROPOLIS — cursed necropolis locked in perpetual unnatural winter; foreground ice-cased tomb-markers, the inscriptions visible through crystal-clear freeze, frozen offerings still in skeletal hands; midground a city of funerary architecture, every surface rime-coated, icicles hanging from arched doorways, paths glittering treacherously, spectral blue light leaking from interior gaps; deep distance the necromancer's cathedral, ice-encased to the pinnacles, its spire glowing cold blue; sky white-black snowfall in windless suspension.

GOREFIELD MIRE — poisoned wetland, plague-pool district of a sunken city; foreground viscous dark water ringed with dead reeds, yellow-tipped and crumbling, motes of bioluminescent decay drifting on the surface; midground flooded market-square ruins, stall-frames still standing in the water at angles, merchandise long rotted, just the wooden bones; deep distance a cathedral half-submerged, rose window intact at water-level, green-lit from within; sky red-grey overcast, the fog carrying a faint sweet-wrong smell implied in the image's stillness.

MOLDERING ASHWOOD — blighted forest at the edge of a volcanic event zone; foreground fallen trees with bark bleached white by heat and gas, lying in parallel rows as though felled by a directed wave; midground standing dead trunks stripped entirely of bark, pale and skeletal, spacing them creates sight-lines across the landscape; deep distance the volcanic ridgeline that caused the blight, still smoking at its shoulders, a dull orange bloom at its summit; sky pale yellow sulphur-hazed ceiling, no clouds, just tint.

RAVENSCAR FORELAND — crumbling dark citadel foreland in shattered highland; foreground a highland approach road of bare rock, waystone markers cracked and toppled at intervals; midground the highland plateau spreading in all directions, wind-carved stone formations twisted into lean silhouettes, no vegetation, the bare-rock landscape scoured clean; deep distance the citadel at the plateau's far edge, its towers silhouetted against the sky, walls intact but battlements bare of defenders and worse for it; sky storm-green, unsettled, lightning implied in distant colour.

THE SUNDERING RIM — abyss-edge landscape at a world-wound border; foreground loose shattered-world debris at the precipice, stones inscribed with runes floating an inch above the ground in defiance of natural law; midground a broad plateau cracked through with fissures glowing pale violet, the cracks deepening toward the rim; deep distance the opposite world-fragment across the void, close enough to see its own ruined spires, impossibly far across the lightless abyss; sky torn, cloud-ceiling split open in a radiating fracture, void visible between.

ASHVEIL PLAIN — cinder-desert scoured by dead winds; foreground cracked obsidian earth split by ember-veined fissures exhaling pale smoke; midground skeletal black ridgelines march in broken formations like the spines of buried giants; deep distance a volcanic massif crowned in permanent ash-cloud bleeds orange at its seams; sky a bruised pewter vault through which no sun is visible, only the suggestion of something burning behind iron clouds.

MIREWOOD THE BLACKENED — blighted forest strangled by corruption; foreground roots like broken fingers clawing upward through soil stained purple-black, dead leaves pressed flat as if by enormous weight; midground leafless trees fused at the canopy into a lightless lattice, bark peeled to reveal pale wood the color of bone; deep distance a smear of sickly green bioluminescence marks the forest's poisoned heart; sky locked in perpetual false dusk, amber-grey and suffocating.

DROWNHALLOW MARSH — cursed wetland of the plague-pool tradition; foreground brackish water reflecting no sky, filmed with iridescent rot, dead reeds standing rigid as spears; midground the sunken towers of a drowned fortress thrust crookedly above the waterline, wrapped in black moss and hanging sedge; deep distance will-o-wisps trace erratic cold-blue paths over the open bog; sky low, grey-green, ceiling-close, pressing the world down like a lid.

THE GREY WOUNDING — sundered abyss-edge landscape at continental scale; foreground shattered flagstones end abruptly at a cliff-lip where nothing exists beyond; midground the canyon below holds coiling void-mist, the far wall miles distant and bleeding cold violet light from exposed strata; deep distance the opposing cliff-face is carved with the remains of a civilization swallowed when the land broke; sky split along the horizon by a crack of cold white light that is not dawn.

SORRENHOLT NECROPOLIS — cursed city of the dead at maximum scale; foreground grave-markers of black iron thrust through cobblestone, some bent almost horizontal by the weight of what lies beneath; midground entire city blocks of hollow-windowed bone-grey buildings, spectral light drifting through empty frames; deep distance a lich-spire rises above the city, its peak dissolving into a crown of green-black necrotic flame; sky moonless, starless, packed with cold grey cloud that pulses faintly in rhythm with something below.

CAELID-WOUND FLATS — demon-touched volcanic wasteland; foreground scarlet-stained earth crusted like a healing wound that will not close, scattered with calcified remnants of something that was once alive; midground blighted trees reduced to red-brown husks lean uniformly eastward as if fleeing; deep distance a massive arcane rupture scar cuts the hillside, glowing at its depths like forge-coals; sky the color of a bruise at its worst, deep red fading to sickened yellow at the horizon.

THORNWASTE OF ESHA — witch-cursed moor under perpetual overcast; foreground blood-stones half-sunk in peat, their surfaces inscribed with spiral marks worn almost smooth; midground the moor stretches without feature save for blackthorn thickets growing in patterns too deliberate to be natural; deep distance a single crooked standing stone larger than a house looms on the far rise; sky roiling low cloud in grey and brown, the wind audible only as silence between heartbeats.

VOLGRATH'S FORELAND — approach to a necromancer-keep across blasted earth; foreground the road paved in dark basalt, cracked, edged with the calcified remains of those who did not pass; midground towers of a great dark citadel resolve from the haze, walls black and featureless as a held breath; deep distance the keep's highest tower burns with a light that is not fire, cold and absolute; sky storm-locked, lightning pressed flat against the cloud-base, illuminating the fortress in stuttering silver.

BLOOD-RIVER VERGE — poisoned wetland where the water runs wrong; foreground the bank is rust-red clay, crumbling at the waterline into the dark current below; midground the river itself moves too slowly, surface gleaming like lacquered mahogany, carrying pale objects that do not bear examination; deep distance a ruined bridge spans the river, its arch partly collapsed, hung with dead vegetation trailing in the current; sky reflected in the water is darker than the actual sky above, as if the river sees a different world.

CINDER-SEA BARRENS — ash plain at Mordor scale; foreground drifts of pale ash soft as snow accumulate against angular volcanic rock, footprints filling silently behind the viewer; midground columns of basalt stand in broken rows across the flat plain like the ruins of a colonnade that never existed; deep distance a mountain range exhales continuous smoke, the peaks invisible, only the orange underbelly of the cloud-mass marking where they must be; sky the ash-haze creates a false ceiling fifty feet overhead, turning the world into a grey interior.

HAGRAVEN'S HEATH — hag-marked cursed moor landscape; foreground fetish-bundles of black feather and split bone hang from rusted iron posts sunk deep in the peat; midground the heath rolls in long dark waves, heather gone black and brittle, the ground between tussocks glistening with standing water the color of old iron; deep distance a ring of dead oaks surrounds a depression in the land where a green fire burns without fuel or wind-flicker; sky sickly amber at the edges, deepening to olive-grey overhead, wrong in a way that cannot be named.

THE OPENED EARTH — sundered land void-canyon descent; foreground the rim of the sundering is razor-edged obsidian shards thrusting upward, the ground here vibrating almost imperceptibly; midground the canyon walls descend past sight, layered in geological strata of impossible color, purple-black and sickle-yellow and deep red; deep distance the canyon floor is invisible beneath void-mist, but something large and deliberate moves within it; sky the rift itself seems to pull at the clouds above, drawing them inward in a slow spiral that should not be possible.

GHOSTMERE — dead marshes of the spectral-army tradition; foreground the water here is glass-still, and within it faces look upward from impossible depths, arranged in the stillness of the long-drowned; midground submerged ruins create a grid beneath the surface, walls and streets still visible in the dark water; deep distance torchlight moves along a causeway barely above the waterline, belonging to no living procession; sky moonlit but wrong, the moon itself hazed into a smear of white behind layers of marsh-mist.

ASHENMOOR CITADEL ROAD — dark citadel approach through blasted heath; foreground the cobbled road is old and the cobbles are black, edged with carved warnings in a script worn to abstraction; midground the road rises gently through moor terrain, flanked by iron-post mile-markers increasingly close together as the fortress nears; deep distance the citadel sits on a low rise of bare rock, its silhouette serrated and lightless, windows dark as missing teeth; sky iron-grey stormlight creating a false late-afternoon that never deepens and never brightens.

YHERRATH THE UNQUIET — cursed necropolis where the architecture is wrong; foreground a city square where the pavement has been pushed upward from beneath in a dozen places, smooth domes of displaced stone; midground entire building facades lean inward over the narrow streets at angles suggesting foundations failing from below; deep distance a great cathedral-scale structure at the city's center has partially inverted, its spires descending into a hole in the earth rather than pointing skyward; sky circling with shapes too large and too dark to be birds.

SULFUR GATE PLAIN — demon-touched hellscape-adjacent terrain; foreground the ground is cracked ceramic, cream and ochre, puffing pale vapor from fractures with each step; midground summoning circles burned permanently into the earth in enormous arcs, connected by channels that glow dull red; deep distance a gateway of black stone stands open in the middle distance, framing nothing but a vertical plane of heated darkness from which light does not escape; sky permanently the color of a fire viewed through red glass, hot and absolutely wrong.

FELLWOOD INTERIOR — blighted forest at full corruption; foreground the soil itself has turned black and moves slightly, as if the corruption beneath has not finished settling; midground the trees here have grown together into arches and tunnels, bark fused, the interiors hollow and deep; deep distance the forest floor drops into a lightless depression a quarter-mile across, and the trees lean toward it in unison; sky visible only as a distant lattice of leafless black branches, the actual sky beyond it invisible, replaced by darkness.

THE GREY BARROWFIELDS — open-grave necropolis district at scale; foreground barrow-mounds in every direction, their capstones displaced, breath visible rising from the openings in the cold; midground between the mounds, the ground is frost-grey and compressed, worn smooth by passage of feet in the night; deep distance a spectral procession is visible at the far edge of the field, translucent ranks moving in a direction that does not correspond to any road; sky bone-white cloud locked overhead, pressing spectral light down onto the field with nowhere to hide.

THE SLICK HOLLOWS — poisoned wetland in perpetual false twilight; foreground the mud at the bank is purple-grey and the vegetation is gone, replaced by crust-formations of mineral deposit in shapes that suggest growth; midground the hollow is a shallow bowl holding dark water and dead wood, standing in patterns too regular to be natural deadfall; deep distance at the hollow's center, a tree larger than the others still stands, white as chalk, leafless, and something vast coils in its upper branches; sky motionless clouds at impossible variety of grey tones, creating a ceiling that looks painted.

OBSIDIAN FAULTLANDS — volcanic wasteland of maximum desolation; foreground volcanic glass in plate-sized shards, edges still sharp after ages, reflecting a broken version of the viewer; midground lava-tube collapses create a field of open pits exhaling hot breath across the flat plain; deep distance a volcano not quite active, not quite dormant, its caldera glowing from within like an eye partially open, ringed by concentric ash-ridges; sky the ash here is so fine it hangs suspended, reducing distance to fifty yards and giving the world a white-grey claustrophobia.

WRAITHFEN OF MORRKAL — cursed marsh in witch-fen tradition; foreground iron-rusted water between hummocks of dead sedge, the surface broken by bubbles that smell of sulfur; midground the fen is enormous and flat, dotted with the silhouettes of standing stones half-submerged and listing, ancient beyond reckoning; deep distance a structure of stone and crusted fen-vegetation rises where the ground is slightly higher, its purpose no longer readable in its shape; sky a permanent green-grey smear of cloud from which fine mist descends without becoming rain, coating everything in cold wet.

CARRION RIDGE APPROACH — dark citadel foreland at scale; foreground the ridge path is narrow and the drop to either side is absolute, the rock below not visible; midground the ridge leads to gatehouse ruins where the arch still stands though the walls around it have long fallen, hung with dead iron chains; deep distance behind the ruined gatehouse the true fortress rises, multiple walls in concentric rings of black stone, intact and inhabited by something that leaves no lights burning; sky permanent overcast the color of an old bruise, leaking occasional cold rain.

BLACKTHORN REACH — witch-realm cursed heath at landscape scale; foreground blackthorn grows in walls here, ancient and dense, the thorns finger-long and glistening despite no moisture visible; midground the heath between thicket-walls is a corridor system, paths leading inward in a spiral geometry only visible from elevation; deep distance the spiral leads to a standing stone whose shadow points the wrong direction regardless of where the diffuse light originates; sky the color of pewter heated and then cooled too fast, cracked-looking, low, oppressive, suggesting weather that has decided to simply remain.

THE HOLLOWED CAPITAL — cursed necropolis at fallen-empire scale; foreground grand processional avenue cracked down its center by something that moved upward, the flagstones on either side tilted like wings; midground palaces and administrative buildings of immense scale stand intact but hollow, every window dark, facades carved with histories of rulers whose names the stonework seems to be forgetting; deep distance a palace of absolute scale at the city's heart, its throne-room dome collapsed inward, the edges of the collapse rimmed with blue-green necrotic light; sky moonlit and cloudless for once, the stars above wrong in their arrangement, unfamiliar, belonging to no mapped sky.

CHARNEL BARRENS — demon-touched scorched earth in Avernus tradition; foreground the ground is black ceramic, heat-fused, cracked into polygons by cooling that happened long ago and left everything in arrested ruin; midground iron structures of indeterminate purpose stand at intervals, too large to be furniture and too small to be fortifications, their function illegible; deep distance the barrens end at a cliff-edge where the land simply stops, and below it a landscape of burning orange extends to a horizon that glows; sky above the barrens is dark and still, below the cliff's edge the sky is fire-lit from beneath, and the transition between them is a line as sharp as a blade.

THE ASHENWOLD — blighted forest of petrified black oaks whose bark weeps dark amber resin; foreground gnarled roots coil across bone-dry soil like frozen serpents, dead leaves pressed flat and lacquered obsidian; midground a corridor of skeletal canopy arches over a path no pilgrim walks twice; deep distance a smear of violet blight-fog swallows the treeline whole; sky a bruised amber membrane through which no true sun pierces.

PLAGUEWATER FEN — cursed marsh reeking of sweetrot and still black water; foreground mossy skulls half-swallowed by the mud, bulrushes blackened at the tip and weeping dark sap; midground a flooded village of sunken timber and bell-towers tilted like broken teeth; deep distance dead willows fade into green-grey miasma; sky a low ceiling of motionless cloud the color of a bruise two days old.

CINDER EXPANSE — volcanic wasteland of cooled lava-glass and smoking fissure-fields; foreground shards of obsidian thrust upward like broken crowns, ash settling in fine grey drifts across cracked earth; midground rivers of sluggish orange magma bisect the plain between ridges of scorched basalt; deep distance a cone of black mountain exhales a column of red-lit smoke; sky perpetual volcanic twilight, orange below, starless black above.

SEPULCHRE WARD — cursed necropolis of open-grave avenues and bone-tower districts; foreground cracked paving stones erupted from below by coffin-timber and pale reaching hands stilled mid-grasp; midground mausoleums four stories high lean against each other like drunken giants, their iron doors long torn free; deep distance a citadel of stacked sarcophagi rises above the fog; sky a cold grey sheet that refuses dawn.
