BLOOD MIRE — poisoned wetland fed by a river running the dark color of old rust; foreground reeds slick with crimson residue fringe a pool whose surface moves without wind; midground a drowned fortress wall emerges from the shallows, chain-wrapped and encrusted with black barnacles; deep distance the flooded plain stretches to a line of dead alders; sky copper-green and heavy, pressing down like a thumb.

DEMON'S CROSSING — infernal-portal field where the earth remembers its desecration; foreground summoning circles etched in dark stone still radiate faint crimson heat, the runes worn but not silent; midground charred obelisks ring a central clearing where the air warps and bends like heat over iron; deep distance a hellfire-cracked ridge glows from within; sky roiling amber clouds lit from below, veined with dry lightning that makes no sound.

HAGMOOR — cursed moor under a permanent overcast the color of pewter; foreground blackthorn thickets wound with dark ribbon-offerings, crow feathers pressed flat into the peat by ancient hands; midground standing blood-stones lean in a broken circle around a central altar slick with old rain; deep distance the moor rises into a witch-fen ridge where shapes that are not trees stand watching; sky a flat cold nothing that gives no shadow.

WRAITHMARSH — will-o-wisp marsh glowing with pale cold foxfire; foreground tufts of dead grass island the black water where spectral lights hover at knee height; midground collapsed monastery arches rise from the flood, their stone colonnade draped in grey waterlogged moss; deep distance the lights multiply into a constellation of false stars hovering above the drowned ruins; sky starless and moonless, a total absence lit only by the cold glow below.

THE GREYFALL APPROACH — crumbling dark citadel foreland at the border of a necromancer-keep; foreground broken siege equipment rots in the churned earth of an approach road no army survived; midground a curtain wall of black granite still stands, its battlements lined with crow-eaten banners; deep distance the keep's central tower leans against the sky like a crooked finger, lit from its arrow-slits with green lantern-light; sky low cloud dragged across the battlements by a wind that smells of iron.

ASHFIELD OF KORRETH — ash-plain where an empire burned and left no heirs; foreground collapsed archways of white ash stand powder-fragile, footsteps obliterating their carved faces; midground a flat grey expanse of packed cinder stretches to the horizon, dotted with the silhouettes of calcified soldiers mid-march; deep distance a mountain range of slag and cooled lava frames the plain; sky a permanent grey-white haze that turns the air to chalk in the throat.

THE ROTWOOD — undead-touched forest where decay is the only season; foreground bark split and blackened, sapwood exposed and threaded through with luminescent blue-white fungal veins; midground ancient oaks still standing but hollow, their interiors lit by the cold light of trapped grave-mist; deep distance the trees thin into a clearing where a collapsed chapel is consumed by root and rot; sky a sickly green-grey where the canopy thins, pulsing faintly with blight-light.

ABYSSAL LEDGE — abyss-edge cliff where the world simply ends; foreground the stone at the rim is vitrified by ancient force, smooth as black glass and warm underfoot despite no visible heat source; midground the ledge extends like a promontory into open void, carved ruins along its spine; deep distance nothing — pure lightless depth into which wind descends but does not return; sky a ceiling of inverted dark stone, the world's underside pressing down like a lid.

WYTCHFEN HOLLOW — witch-realm of cursed heath and sacrificial bloodstone fields; foreground heather-turned-black carpets the ground, each flower head sealed shut and brittle as old bone; midground a grid of bloodstones marks a field where nothing has grown since the rite; deep distance a hag-tower of twisted timber and wicker stands silhouetted on the rise, every window dark; sky perpetual evening light the color of a dying ember, cold and directionless.

DEAD MARCHES OF VAREK — spectral-army camp on an endless fog-buried plain; foreground tattered standards planted in soft earth, their heraldry long rotted to grey shapes; midground the ranked silhouettes of phantom soldiers stand motionless in formations that span the full width of vision; deep distance the fog closes over their rear ranks, swallowing thousands into white silence; sky a colourless void that blurs into fog at its lowest point.

THE SCORCH VALE — demon-touched scorched-earth valley split by hellfire channels; foreground cracked clay tiles the earth, each fracture glowing faint orange like cooling metal; midground a chain of hellfire pits runs the valley floor, each crowned with a slow pillar of black smoke; deep distance valley walls of obsidian-streaked basalt converge on a central arch of fused stone; sky blood-red above the valley, fading to soot-black at the zenith, no clouds, only smoke.

BLACKWATER DELTA — poisoned wetland where three cursed rivers meet; foreground oil-black water inches toward the viewer, its surface iridescent and perfectly still; midground a delta fan of dead mangrove trunks stands knee-deep in the flood, each trunk wrapped in dark trailing moss; deep distance the merged river vanishes into a fog-bank of sickly yellow-green; sky overcast the color of old bone, uniform and featureless, reflecting nothing.

NECROPOLIS OF VALMUND — lich-king capital frozen mid-collapse; foreground paving stones of dark marble crack under frost-heave, the grout lines traced in persistent grey ice; midground grand boulevards flanked by colonnades of crumbling statuary with faces worn smooth by centuries of cold wind; deep distance a palace of black spires stands intact above the ruin, its highest tower lit by a single pale-blue flame; sky absolute winter, colourless and crushing, no warmth anywhere in it.

THE WITHER GROVE — hag-marked wood of blackthorn and blood-root; foreground blackthorn tangles bar the path, each thorn the length of a finger, tips stained dark; midground the grove opens into a dell where a ring of pale birches has been stripped to white bone-wood, their bark peeled and piled at the roots; deep distance the treeline closes again into impenetrable dark; sky visible only in tatters through the canopy, a wounded grey-orange.

MOLTEN SCAR — volcanic wasteland of lava-cracked plains and smoking-fissure ridges; foreground volcanic glass crunches underfoot, each shard reflecting distorted versions of a red sky; midground a plain of cooled basalt plateaus at different heights, separated by glowing channels; deep distance a volcanic ridge runs wall-like across the horizon, its crest jagged and back-lit by deep magma-orange; sky a convection of ash-cloud and heated air that bends light and makes distance uncertain.

RUINWALL FORELAND — fortress approach at the fall-of-empire vista; foreground a road of cracked imperial flagstones leads forward, edged with toppled mile-markers carved with warnings in dead script; midground the outer curtain wall has partially collapsed, its rubble field forming a maze before the gatehouse; deep distance the keep rises in silhouette against a sky the color of a dying fire, impossibly tall and wrong in its proportions; sky ragged cloud dragged through the battlements, tearing on the spires.

THE HOLLOW STEPPE — sundered land where the terrain simply disagrees with itself; foreground the ground tilts at angles that the eye tells the brain cannot be right; midground shelves of earth at mismatched elevations create a staircase landscape leading nowhere, each shelf edged in crumbling stone; deep distance the land falls away into a chasm that cuts the horizon like an axe-wound; sky a pale, anemic light that casts no true shadow, leaving depth ambiguous and threatening.

CHAINED PLAIN — hellscape-adjacent field of chained-soul markers across scorched earth; foreground iron stakes driven into cracked ground, each trailing a length of dark chain that ends in nothing; midground the stakes extend in rows to the horizon, thousands of them, the chains singing faintly in an infernal wind; deep distance an arch of black iron frames a portal-shimmer at the plain's far end; sky dark amber, layered with smoke-strata that pulse with buried heat.

SWAMPVEIL RUIN — drowned-fortress wetland at maximum atmospheric depth; foreground knotted cypress roots breach the water's surface, trailing moss the color of old copper; midground the fortress wall rises from the flood, its lower stones green-slicked and its parapets broken, silhouetted against fog; deep distance the fog is lit from within by a diffuse sickly phosphorescence with no identifiable source; sky hidden entirely behind mist, replaced by a flat sourceless glow.

SOULCAIRN TUNDRA — cursed necropolis-moor hybrid of frozen grave-fields; foreground permafrost earth heaved and cracked, the soil between ice-veins the color of ash, grave-markers of black antler jutting at angles; midground a broad tundra of dead silver grass bends flat in a wind that makes no sound; deep distance pale towers of carved bone rise against the horizon, enormous and alien in their geometry; sky a void of deep indigo, lit by no moon, threaded with slow aurora the color of cold fire.

THORNMERE BLIGHTED WOOD — undead-touched forest where every trunk splits and weeps black sap; foreground gnarled root-knuckles erupting from blood-soaked earth, draped in grey funeral moss; midground a coliseum of blackened oaks whose crowns have fused into a canopy of petrified claw-shapes; deep distance a pale sickly fog consuming the deeper grove entirely; sky glimpsed only in thin broken shards between dead branches, bruised violet and wrong.

BLACKWATER FEN — plague-pool wetland where the water itself carries corruption; foreground shallow black water reflecting no sky, laced with iridescent oil-slick spirals and half-submerged bones; midground a labyrinth of rotting peat-hummocks and leafless grey willow-skeletons trailing skeletal fingers into the mire; deep distance a drowned fortress, its towers collapsed inward, swallowed to the parapets; sky pewter-heavy, breathing a cold mist that smells of old iron.

ASHENVEIL RIDGE — Mordor-coded volcanic wasteland at its most oppressive; foreground volcanic glass shards jutting from grey pumice at irregular angles, edges sharp enough to catch the lava-glow and throw it blood-red; midground a wide plain of smoking fissures exhaling columns of black gas; deep distance a lone obsidian peak crowned by a perpetual pillar of fire; sky a bruised canopy of ash-cloud lit ember-orange from below, like the lid of a furnace.

SOULMARSH OF THE DROWNED HOST — dead-marshes wetland where the fallen stare upward through still water; foreground pale ghost-lights hovering inches above black standing water, trembling but never moving; midground an endless shallow lake of dark water, its bed littered with the pale shapes of armored figures lying motionless beneath the surface; deep distance a broken aqueduct of crumbled grey stone vanishing into fog; sky colourless and flat, neither day nor night, simply absent of hope.

THE KNIFEWOOD — hag-marked blighted forest spiked with razor-bark trees; foreground bone-white saplings twisted into spiral forms, their bark peeling to reveal black cores; midground a dense tangle of thorn-trees whose branches interlock overhead into a vaulted cathedral of spikes, dead leaves the colour of dried wounds carpeting the floor; deep distance a single collapsed watchtower consumed by the forest; sky invisible behind the thorned canopy, its presence felt only as oppressive grey pressure.

CINDERFIELD OF MOLOCH'S WAKE — demon-touched scorched-earth where an infernal rite left the land permanently branded; foreground ritual circles scored deep into blackened earth, their grooves still holding a sullen red ember-glow; midground a vast field of scorched stone tablets tilted at wrong angles, ancient script burned into their faces; deep distance a colossal archway of fused obsidian and bone-ash, cracked but standing; sky a ceiling of rust-red cloud, static and unmoving, as though painted onto glass.

OSSUARY CITY OF VAELTHORN — cursed necropolis where the architecture is partially bone; foreground cobblestones of yellowed flat bone fitted together with black mortar, cracked and uneven underfoot; midground a wide boulevard flanked by towers of fused skulls mortared into walls, dark windows gaping like eye-sockets; deep distance a cathedral spire of bone and tarnished iron leaning five degrees off true, impossibly tall; sky a deep purple-black bruise overhead, lit by cold spectral light with no visible source.

THE GRIEF MOOR — cursed hag-haunted moorland under permanent twilight; foreground heather reduced to black straw, blood-stones jutting at intervals, each carved with a weeping face worn smooth; midground a rolling expanse of dead heath in every direction, the ground occasionally shuddering as though something shifts beneath; deep distance a ring of standing stones on the horizon, massive and silhouetted against nothing; sky a flat grey void offering neither sun nor stars, simply the colour of erasure.

CAULDRON VALE — volcanic glass wasteland in a sunken valley caldera; foreground sheets of obsidian rippled like frozen water, edges catching ember-light in vicious orange sparks; midground a lake of cooled but still-cracked lava forming an alien black landscape of frozen waves; deep distance the caldera walls rising sheer and dark, streaked with old lava-flows in rust and ochre; sky a narrow oval of visibility above the caldera rim, choked with rising black smoke.

THE SUNDERING SHELF — abyss-edge sundered-land cliff of catastrophic scale; foreground broken flagstones of a former road ending abruptly at the cliff edge, the last stones dangling over nothing; midground a sheer cliff face of fractured dark granite dropping into a void of absolute darkness, its depth unmeasurable; deep distance across the void the matching cliff-face of the other sundered continent, so far it is only a dark shape in purple haze; sky a wound-coloured aurora above the abyss, beautiful and wrong.

ROTFALL GROVE — blood-soaked root forest in active blight; foreground exposed tree-roots the diameter of columns, their surfaces slick and dark red as though the earth beneath bleeds; midground enormous petrified trees fused into walls of organic black wood, their bark scaled like old iron; deep distance a hollow at the grove's heart where a dead tree of enormous size has collapsed inward, creating a crater filled with black water; sky filtered to a dim arterial red by the canopy above.

DEADMIRE CROSSING — cursed marsh where a sunken bridge-city has been reclaimed by the swamp; foreground cracked bridge-stones colonised by black algae, standing water between them shin-deep and opaque; midground the submerged rooftops and broken arches of a drowned city, their upper edges breaching the waterline like broken teeth; deep distance a tower still standing to full height, its interior lit by cold blue spectral fire; sky a heavy greenish murk offering diffuse unpleasant light and the constant threat of rain.

THE LICH-KING'S ESPLANADE — open-grave city district where the dead walk in open ceremony; foreground great rectangular pits opened in the city square, their edges lined with dark stone, depths lost in shadow; midground a vast processional avenue flanked by colossus statues of armored figures holding chains, all slightly wrong in proportion; deep distance a palace of dark marble and iron rising above the city, its highest tower crowned with a sickly green flame; sky moonless black, cold starlight casting no warmth, only strange hard shadows.

AVERNUS THRESHOLD — hellscape-adjacent demon-touched land where the border between worlds has burned through; foreground scorched red earth cracked into a mosaic of deep fissures exhaling heat-shimmer; midground a chain of massive iron pillars driven into the ground at angles, each wrapped in rusted chain of impossible scale; deep distance a rift in the earth wide enough to swallow armies, lit from below by hellfire orange; sky a bruised crimson, cloudless but wrong, the colour of a sky that has never known anything benign.

THE WYTCH-FEN — witch-realm blackthorn waste merged into stagnant wetland; foreground dense blackthorn tangles at water's edge, their thorns long as finger-bones and black as pitch; midground a fen of stagnant dark water broken by hummocks of dead grass, will-o-wisp lights drifting without pattern; deep distance a hag's tower of black peat-brick leaning over the water, its top lost in hanging grey fog; sky perpetual cloud the colour of a healing bruise, pressing down hard.

SMOLDERING BARRENS — ash-plain cinder-desert under a collapsed sky; foreground fine pale ash ankle-deep, disturbed by each step into slow grey plumes that take minutes to settle; midground a wasteland of buried ruins, only their tallest cornices breaching the ash-surface; deep distance a mountain-sized slag heap of compacted cinder and fused stone, its upper rim glowing red; sky a horizontal curtain of ash-fall catching volcanic light from below, the flakes drifting upward as much as down, gravity subtly wrong.

NECROPOLIS OF A THOUSAND CROWNS — lich-kingdom fallen capital where every ruler was cursed to remain; foreground a wide plaza tiled in tarnished silver, each tile engraved with a royal seal, many of the seals cracked; midground a city of black-stone palaces compressed together, their facades carved with royal portraits all wearing expressions of locked anguish; deep distance a central citadel of night-black marble rising above all, its dome cracked open from within by something that grew; sky thick with cold fog that glows faint green near the citadel's wound.

WORLD-WOUND CANYON — sundered-land abyss-edge where the earth tore apart in a single terrible moment; foreground the sheared cliff-edge, its rock-face showing clean strata sliced impossibly smooth, as though cut rather than broken; midground the canyon interior, impossibly wide and impossibly deep, its walls threaded with veins of dark purple crystal that pulse with imprisoned wrongness; deep distance the far wall of the canyon partially obscured by a permanent interior weather system of purple lightning-laced cloud; sky fractured above the wound, showing split bands of light and darkness.

HOLLOWGATE FORELAND — dark-citadel border fortress approach across a dead valley; foreground a rutted road of cracked dark stone littered with abandoned shields and broken standards half-buried in grey mud; midground a dead valley of bare grey earth, treeless, perfectly silent, its flatness interrupted by mass-grave mounds arranged in rows; deep distance the fortress itself on the valley's far ridge, a brutalist monolith of black basalt with no decorative elements, only murder-holes and iron; sky low cloud catching the fortress's signal-fires, turning the ceiling a dull furious orange.

PENITENT MARSH — will-o-wisp cursed wetland of the condemned; foreground cracked dark mud at the marsh's edge embedded with upright corroded iron stakes, a warning from someone who cared once; midground open black water broken by the half-submerged ruins of stone cells, their bars still intact, their occupants no longer there; deep distance a distant black shore barely visible through layers of cold ground-mist; sky the colour of old pewter, absolutely motionless, a sky made of silence.

THE GRIEF-GLASS WASTE — demon-touched hellscape-adjacent scorched plain fused to black glass; foreground sheets of black glass rippled and bubbled from ancient hellfire, the surface reflecting a distorted mirror of the sky above; midground the plain stretching without variation for miles, broken only by ruined pillars of fused iron and stone at irregular intervals; deep distance a structure of collapsed arches and melted walls where something enormous burned from the inside; sky starless black above, the only light the faint red seam of a distant eternal fire at the horizon.

BARROW HEATH — cursed moor thick with burial mounds under wrong moonlight; foreground knee-high black grass crackling as though frost-killed in midsummer, the soil between it unnaturally dark; midground a rolling heath covered in barrow-mounds of various sizes, their entryways sealed with flat dark stones carved with warning-runes worn almost smooth; deep distance a ridgeline silhouette of standing stones so close together they form a near-wall; sky a bloated wrong moon casting blue-white light that makes every shadow longer than geometry allows.

THE SILENT MARCHES — spectral-army encampment frozen in permanent cursed stillness; foreground churned battlefield earth with broken weapons embedded at angles, the ground between them stained deep and dark; midground a vast encampment of translucent pavilions that exist slightly outside true physical reality, their spectral forms holding formation in perfect military order; deep distance a banner of a long-dead kingdom snapping in a wind that touches nothing else; sky absolute darkness above, light existing only as a sourceless grey ambient pressing from no direction, throwing no shadows.

VEINCRACK CHASM — sundered continent abyss-edge where dark crystal corruption grows in the wound; foreground shards of dark violet crystal erupting from fractured stone at the chasm lip, each shard humming at a frequency just below hearing; midground the chasm interior descending in wide shelf-steps, each level colonised by larger crystal formations growing against gravity, pointing upward; deep distance the chasm floor invisible, lost in a purple luminescent mist that rises slowly but never escapes; sky a thin strip of bruised sky visible above the crack, rapidly being occluded by crystal growth on both walls.

ASHVEIL FLATS — cinder-desert wasteland where nothing breathes; foreground: cracked volcanic glass sheeting underfoot, each shard etched with frost-black veins and still-warm ash drifts pressing against bone-pale stones; midground: a miles-wide plain of cooled lava channels splitting the earth like a diseased hide, ancient obsidian monoliths tilting at wrong angles; deep distance: a ridge-wall of perpetually smoking fissures crowning the horizon like a jagged crown of ruin; sky: bruised sulfur-orange pressed flat and lightless overhead, the sun a smothered coal behind volcanic murk.

DROWNMERE REACHES — cursed blackwater marsh where the dead remember the living; foreground: submerged flagstones of a sunken road visible beneath oily water, pale marsh-flowers floating face-up like drowned offerings around twisted root-knees; midground: a vast stagnant flood choked with standing dead timber, bark stripped white as bone, carrying softly luminous wisps that drift with terrible patience through the fog; deep distance: the half-submerged towers of a drowned fortress city jutting from the water, slumped and vine-choked; sky: a ceiling of iron-grey fog pressing the world flat, no horizon visible, only degrees of enclosing dark.

THORNVAST WOOD — blighted forest realm where the corruption runs root-deep; foreground: blackened bark peeling from trunks in ash-paper strips, roots surfacing from black soil in clutching arcs, dried blood-dark sap glazing every wound in the wood; midground: an endless colonnade of dead-standing trees whose canopy has fused into a ceiling of interlocked dead branches blocking all sky, the forest floor carpeted in grey-white spore-dust unmarked by any living track; deep distance: the silhouette of an immense ruined hag-tower swallowed almost entirely by the fused treeline, lit from within by a sickly pale light; sky: visible only in rare splinters between branch-lattice, the color of a bruise deepening toward black.
